items.text: BSc electronics career options include service and repair, embedded and IoT work, testing and quality, telecom support, technical sales and further study, and employers weigh circuit understanding and hands-on projects heavily over the degree name.
Choose between service, embedded, testing and sales, build two working circuits or devices and learn the basic tools.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
